mapper.sql:
FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN departments ON courses.department_id = departments.id JOIN professors ON lectures.professor_id = professors.id JOIN users ON professors.user_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id
AND courses.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchReq.courseName}, '%')
AND users.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchReq.professorName}, '%')
AND departments.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchReq.departmentName}, '%')
AND semesters.academic_year = #{searchReq.year}
AND semesters.term = IF(#{searchReq.semester} = 1, 'FIRST', 'SECOND')
AND courses.code = #{searchReq.courseCode}
mapper.select: SELECT lectures.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, NULL AS target_grade, departments.name AS department_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, lectures.capacity, semesters.academic_year AS academic_year, semesters.term, lectures.midterm_ratio AS midterm_ratio, lectures.final_ratio AS final_ratio, lectures.assignment_ratio AS assignment_ratio, lectures.attendance_ratio AS attendance_ratio FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN departments ON courses.department_id = departments.id JOIN professors ON lectures.professor_id = professors.id JOIN users ON professors.user_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT lectures.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, NULL AS target_grade, departments.name AS department_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, lectures.capacity, semesters.academic_year AS academic_year, semesters.term, lectures.midterm_ratio AS midterm_ratio, lectures.final_ratio AS final_ratio, lectures.assignment_ratio AS assignment_ratio, lectures.attendance_ratio AS attendance_ratio
ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT lectures.id, courses.code AS course_code, courses.name AS course_name, courses.credits, NULL AS target_grade, departments.name AS department_name, users.name AS professor_name, lectures.classroom, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( CASE day_of_week WHEN 'MON' THEN '월요일' WHEN 'TUE' THEN '화요일' WHEN 'WED' THEN '수요일' WHEN 'THU' THEN '목요일' WHEN 'FRI' THEN '금요일' ELSE day_of_week END, ' ', LPAD(start_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':00 ~ ', LPAD(end_period + 8, 2, '0'), ':50' ) SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM lecture_schedules WHERE lecture_id = lectures.id) AS schedule, lectures.capacity, semesters.academic_year AS academic_year, semesters.term, lectures.midterm_ratio AS midterm_ratio, lectures.final_ratio AS final_ratio, lectures.assignment_ratio AS assignment_ratio, lectures.attendance_ratio AS attendance_ratio FROM lectures JOIN courses ON lectures.course_id = courses.id JOIN departments ON courses.department_id = departments.id JOIN professors ON lectures.professor_id = professors.id JOIN users ON professors.user_id = users.id JOIN semesters ON lectures.semester_id = semesters.id WHERE lectures.professor_id = (SELECT id FROM professors WHERE user_id = #{professorId}) ORDER BY semesters.academic_year DESC, semesters.term DESC, courses.name ASC

SELECT id, semester_id AS semesterId, course_id AS courseId, professor_id AS professorId, section_no AS sectionNo, capacity, classroom, status, midterm_ratio AS midtermRatio, final_ratio AS finalRatio, assignment_ratio AS assignmentRatio, attendance_ratio AS attendanceRatio FROM lectures WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture_schedules (lecture_id, day_of_week, start_period, end_period) VALUES (#{lectureId}, #{schedule.dayOfWeek}, #{schedule.startPeriod}, #{schedule.endPeriod})
mapper.select: SELECT NULL AS college_id, NULL AS college_code, NULL AS college_name, id AS dept_id, code AS dept_code, name AS dept_name FROM departments WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY code ASC
